  • Method Details

    • config

      public InlineToolkitRunner.Builder config(InlineTuiConfig config)
      Sets the inline TUI configuration.

      Use this to configure terminal settings (tick rate, poll timeout, clear-on-close, etc.). All builder methods (including bindings(Bindings)) use last-write-wins semantics.

      Parameters:
      config - the configuration
      Returns:
      this builder
